scope: Raw Codex hook stdin payloads to bounded L03 semantic candidates. All identities are synthetic; local paths in inputs are dropped by the parser and never appear in candidates.

fixtures.name: sessionstart-startup-binds
fixtures.notes: Bootstrap context is the constant instruction and opens no turn.

fixtures.name: sessionstart-resume-binds
fixtures.notes: Resume re-binds the same observed identity; no new session is selected.

fixtures.name: sessionstart-compact-silent
fixtures.notes: Compact continuations bind nothing; no false fresh-session binding.

fixtures.name: stop-completes-turn-without-result
fixtures.notes: Stop is turn telemetry only; no candidate kind can submit or accept a result.

fixtures.name: sessionend-ends-session
fixtures.notes: Advisory end; output never steers the session.

fixtures.name: pretooluse-starts-tool
fixtures.notes: Tool input is never forwarded; only name and call identity cross the boundary.

fixtures.name: posttooluse-completes-tool
fixtures.notes: No outcome is inferred from untyped tool output.

fixtures.name: interrupt-marks-interruption
fixtures.notes: Interruption is telemetry; hook output cannot restart the turn.

fixtures.name: userpromptsubmit-opens-turn
fixtures.notes: A submitted prompt is an honestly observed turn start.

fixtures.name: permissionrequest-stays-silent
fixtures.notes: Native approval dialogs are distinct from BFB attention requests and never become candidates.

fixtures.name: subagentstop-stays-silent
fixtures.notes: Subagent activity is not run-turn activity.

rejections: SessionStart with an unknown source fails closed instead of binding.
SessionStart or turn events with missing or malformed session identities fail closed.
SessionEnd with an unexpected reason fails closed.
Malformed JSON, duplicate keys, and oversized payloads fail closed.
